summary: Describes what mailing list software should do once email addresses can contain non-ASCII characters (internationalized addresses). It gives specific recommendations for how lists should behave in various situations, such as when members or the list itself use such addresses. It is an experimental specification. It was replaced by RFC 6783.

eli5.summary: A mailing list is like a club that copies every letter to all members. This explains how the club should cope when some members' addresses are written with letters from other alphabets.

questions: how do mailing lists handle internationalized email addresses
